run_mesh_processing_oakink: run the script to process all oakink dataset meshes in parallel with bimanual embodiment
run_mesh_processing_hot3d: run the script to process all hot3d dataset meshes in parallel with a specified embodiment type
run_mesh_processing_custom_workers: run the script to process meshes using a custom number of parallel worker processes
get_available_tasks_oakink: get a list of available task names from oakink pkl files filtered by embodiment type
get_available_tasks_hot3d: get a list of available task names from hot3d dataset folders for a given embodiment type
